variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick at the north gate, shut by Halvard because of Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Step back from that gate, lad! Unless you WANT to get robbed!

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: Fair try at sweet talk. But that doesn't open the gate! Now off with you!

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Only the Reeve's men may use this gate!

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: Hurk, the guard at the gate of Skarn Delve, who suspects the player of hitting Nib

first.speaker: Hurk
first.text: Hold it right there, stranger! Nib says you hit him with a pick for no reason and his bruises prove it! Let's go. There's a cold and tidy cell waiting for you! Will you come quietly, stranger?

again.speaker: Hurk
again.text:
I would stay out of the Lower Shafts...

unless you want a Troll to chew on you.

variants.specifics: Gorrow: Thoss, the guard at the landing gate of Gorrow, where the Mudmen have lately crept under the walks

first.speaker: Thoss
first.text: Onto the boards, stranger! Enjoy your stay!

again.speaker: Thoss
again.text: You let a few Mudmen frighten you!? You're useless! Now go home! You sicken me!

later.speaker: Thoss
later.text:
Stop right there, stranger! Gwoll swears the Mudmen are creeping under the south walk and the claw marks on the posts prove it.

Let's go! I've got a damp and snug shelter set aside for you.

Will you come quietly, stranger?

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: Hulm, a guard at the north gate of Karth Vael; later, once Grolm is dead.

first.speaker: Hulm
first.text: Hey, you ought to get a proper cloak.

again.speaker: Hulm
again.text: Wanna try the stocks for size?

later.speaker: Hulm
later.text: Commander Ostrag, here is the stranger who finished off Grolm and now seeks to serve the garrison!

variants.specifics: Orlmere: Gurtle, gate guard at the pier gate of Orlmere, turns strangers away because of the drowned dead.

again.speaker: Gurtle
again.text: What are you doing? The gate is about to close! You'd better get inside if you hope to see morning. The dead are rising.

variants.specifics: Zorreth: Gorvo, guard at the college gate of Zorreth.

first.speaker: Gorvo
first.text: We don't see many travelers at the gate these days.

again.speaker: Gorvo
again.text: Hey who left the gate unlatched?

later.speaker: Gorvo
later.text: Oh, bless you. That was a bold thing to do.

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: Brek, guard at the Pass Gate of Kell Varn

first.speaker: Brek
first.text: Warden Odrin is waiting in the Long Hall. He has the key to the Pass Gate.

again.speaker: Brek
again.text: You've got the wrong guard, sorry.

later.speaker: Brek
later.text: Did you see where the Captain went? He wouldn't have left without a word!

variants.specifics: Ashkar: Tobb, gate guard of Ashkar, wary of strangers because of the Trolls.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: Stranger! Ugh! I've heard what the Trolls do to travelers on the road! Turn back!

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text: We will hold the gate here, but you must report to Maldrek in the Guildhall. Thanks for coming, brave Adventurer!

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: That Troll just walked into the furnace before my very eyes!

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: Gurm, a guard at the crossroads post, talks of the Trolls at the North Bridge.

first.speaker: Gurm
first.text: Keep your chin up, stranger, the Trolls will break on our spears!

again.speaker: Gurm
again.text: We must hold the line and repay those who were lost on the bridge!

later.speaker: Gurm
later.text: I feel a strange hope on the road today! Is there any news at all from the Hollow?

variants.specifics: Tosk: Fenn, a guard at the gate of Tosk, jeers at the player, then keeps the watch against the Ogres.

first.speaker: Fenn
first.text: Hide, stranger, hide! Hah, hah, hah...!

again.speaker: Fenn
again.text: You're pretty clean for an Ogre hunter.

later.speaker: Fenn
later.text: No, we cannot feast while the Ogres threaten Tosk!
